meaning: Authored design weights, not measured style attribution
anchor: Goat 4 cream / citrus orange / cocoa palette and cute helper personality

recipes.name: Field Scout
recipes.intent: Protective hood, raised brow, compact utility body; calm covered-face presence.
recipes.critique: Protective brow and lower mask distinguish the explorer. Candy sparkle and extra torso lines compete with the seed; simplify in later studies.

recipes.name: Hop Helper
recipes.intent: Round head, reaching limbs and buoyant body pose; connected candy adaptation.
recipes.critique: Strong hop and open gesture. A neutral view is still needed to judge underlying proportions separately from pose.

recipes.name: Pocket Companion
recipes.intent: Near-round helmet, large friendly face and small compact body.
recipes.critique: Rounder hood and larger face read clearly, but the overall architecture remains close to Goat 4.

recipes.name: Trail Tender
recipes.intent: Protective hood with a narrower torso and visibly longer limbs.
recipes.critique: Candy shortens the torso and legs substantially; broad flank accents still read as suit panels.

recipes.name: Canopy Keeper
recipes.intent: A rounded canopy sweeps into the shoulders, creating a wider original upper-body outline.
recipes.critique: Canopy integration is strongest at head and shoulders; the lower body remains separate. Candy keeps the signature outline.

recipes.name: Pod Pal
recipes.intent: A vertically oval seed-pod hood, tapered torso and medium-length rounded mittens.
recipes.critique: Tall hood transfers clearly. Candy merges the arms more closely into the body, with a deeper foot notch.

recipes.name: Sower Scout
recipes.intent: A gently tapered protective hood, moderate limbs and a clear friendly face, balanced across all three roots.
recipes.critique: Candy preserves the overall proportions better. Mittens remain large; the cowl and frontal pose still sit close to the favorite family.

supportingStudies.name: Canopy candy / three views
supportingStudies.caption: M45/W10/B45. Front, side and back illustrations expose the profile question; they are not verified projections of one object.

supportingStudies.name: Paint-style hop / six proposed poses
supportingStudies.caption: M15/W70/B15. Readable pose progression, with some hood and body proportion drift. A fixed template is the next test.
